newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee drifts lower, trading quiet before NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee drifts lower, trading quiet before NY.

text.p: Mixed speculator buying dragged robusta coffee futures off earlier lows in the early part of Monday's session but activity was subdued ahead of the New York open, traders said.
Earlier, light trade selling pressured benchmark September down to an intraday low of $1,585 but the lower prices quickly attracted bargain-hunters, they said.
Nearby positions on the London market opened between $5 and $8 weaker and all traded positions had lost ground by the midday break.
September stood $11 lower at $1,607 while second-month November was down $4 at $1,606. Volume totalled a light 861 lots.
"There's nothing going on," said one trader, adding that the main feature of interest had been a fire alarm which disrupted floor trading at London's LIFFE exchange.
Although there was no fire, LIFFE's Commodity Quay building had to be evacuated after an alarm which sounded at 0925 GMT. Contracts re-opened at 1005 GMT.
Technical analysts said the September contract was likely to do more support-building ahead of any attack on strong resistance at $1,700.
